definitions: Place (a document or a number of documents) in a particular order, especially for preservation or reference.
Submit (a legal document or charge) to a court or other authority.
Walk in a line, one after another.
Use a tool (a file) to smooth or shape (something).
examples: She needs to file these reports by Friday.
The lawyer will file a complaint.
The students filed out of the classroom.
He used the tool to file down the rough edges.
